sdrplay_installer.installer_label: SDRplay RSP API Install Package V3.15 (installer v2)

limits: Complete Qt and all dependency SDKs were not freshly rebuilt; clean first-party builds reused the exact qualified dependency SDKs.
Qt replacement probes used compatible copies with inert PE/ELF trailers; this proves substitution/loading without an application signature lock, not arbitrary ABI compatibility.
Debian source files were obtained over HTTPS and checked against .dsc SHA256; uploader signatures were not independently verified.
Native macOS qualification, long-duration live RF acceptance, codec patents and external-media rights are outside this license review.
development_findings: Separated build facts from provider declarations after an initial collection failure.
Flattened extracted upstream notice filenames while preserving original member paths and bytes after a Windows path-length failure.

Two native directory commit failures preceded the generic bounded Windows retry; temporary and persistent directory-reader tests verify success/failure atomicity and UTF-8 diagnostics. System protection was not disabled.
A PowerShell file-execution policy blocked one process-module probe; the successful probe used read-only native Win32 APIs without changing that policy.
